scope: Strict location-scoped response envelope for the Comprehensive Status Gateway route.

constraints.extra_fields: forbidden at envelope and location entry levels
constraints.scope: selected_locations only; exactly one selected location identifier
constraints.location_entries: zero or one; when present it must match the selected location identifier
constraints.request_path: selected location identifier must match the location in the route path
constraints.response_size: existing 512 KiB serialized response bound is preserved

limitations: The 14 section payload bodies remain JSON-compatible domain projections rather than field-by-field strict models; changing them needs a source audit across all section generators to avoid dropping legacy capabilities.
This source/API contract does not establish live OIDC behavior, populated-data parity, or broader tenant isolation.
